keyFeaturesAndFixes: Repairs Live Brawl public scoring with five server-assigned actors and one authoritative scorer for every answer target across four categories.
Supports human-to-bot, bot-to-human, and bot-to-bot score decisions without fake human sessions.
Adds idempotent server-authoritative score, dispute, bot-challenge, timeout, and round-completion commands.
Hardens RPC permissions, enforces the five-actor/four-category room contract, and rejects disputes outside the capability and deadline window.
Materializes the v2 scoring projection from the server-owned reveal lifecycle without exposing the materializer RPC to clients.
Includes the three migrations omitted from the historical 1.1.0 manifest: dispute points persistence, designated picker start, and five-second search.
Preserves legacy ruleset v1 rooms and the 1.1.0 / Android build 9 baseline.
